_comment: Personal hybrid source registry. Each entry is a capacity pool with a cost class and an access path; the institutional analogue is the deployment ladder in litellm.config.yaml. This is the EduCloud federation in miniature: four independent meters, free-before-metered, scarce tier reserved. 'access' is the honest part: cli = real terminal binary on your subscription; api = separate per-token meter; app = no CLI exists, launcher only.

sources.name: codex
sources.meter: ChatGPT Plus 5h window (shared with ChatGPT Work / Excel agent)

sources.name: claude
sources.meter: Max 5x shared wallet (5h + weekly + tighter Opus cap)

sources.name: sonar
sources.meter: $5/mo Pro credits (no rollover), then per-token + per-request

sources.name: perplexity-pro
sources.meter: Pro consumer tier (separate from Sonar API credits)
best_at: Deep Research (Opus-powered, off your Claude wallet)
sources.note: No CLI exists for the consumer tier. Highest-value underused asset — the launcher exists so it stays in the same muscle memory as the CLIs.
